visa-preparation.entry_summary: A visa is needed to enter Eritrea, and an exit permit is needed to leave; the exit permit can take a long time and may be refused. A departure tax is paid in US dollars.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: No online route on the official pages read: apply through an Eritrean embassy or consulate.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Get the visa from an Eritrean mission before travel, ask about the exit permit and the departure tax amount, and carry a yellow fever certificate (needed again on leaving).

steps.step: Apply for a visa through the nearest Eritrean embassy or consulate.
Declare all electronic items on arrival (laptops, phones, cameras); undeclared items can be confiscated on leaving.
Apply for an exit permit before leaving; it can take a long time and may be refused, and the Australian Government can't influence it.
Pay the departure tax in US dollars (residents with a valid Eritrean resident permit are exempt).

documents: US dollars for the departure tax
